title: 古龙风云录
notes: Started from Highball's library (`steam.exe -silent -applaunch 2340650`), played for about 6 minutes (11:58:51 to 12:04:38, the last write to its log): the outdoor world map around 谦远镖局, a side-quest trail, and a full turn-based battle on the hex grid (江小鱼's party against 魍星). Both captures are 3824x2158 and 3830x2158, i.e. 2x of a 1920x1080 desktop. Frame rate on the Metal HUD (bottom left): 48.12 fps walking the world map, 38.32 fps in the hex battle. That is well below the other three Steam games I ran today — 觅长生, 大侠立志传 and 群侠传，启动！ all sat near the 160 Hz refresh — but it was steady, with no stutter, no hitch and nothing misbehaving on screen at that rate. The game's own settings are why it does not go higher: `System.setting` has FullScreen 1, 1920x1080, VSync true, `Graphics.QualityLevel` 2, PostProcessVolume 2, shadows on at distance 80. Its own startup banner reports `Screen: 1920x1080@160 Hz`, so it renders at the desktop resolution and does not switch the display. Unity 2020.1.6f1 (Mono), 64-bit, D3D11 (feature level 11_1). DXMT loaded and did not fall back to wined3d. No mods: there is no `steamapps/workshop/content/2340650`. Nothing to report — no crash, and the session ended cleanly with a save (`SaveData/save01`, 12:04:30). Its own `Player.log` carries the usual asset noise (23x `Exception: The left eye object hasn't been assigned.` out of `RealisticEyeMovements.EyeAndHeadAnimator.Awake`, 4x `IndexOutOfRangeException` out of `FSG.MeshAnimator`, 3x `NullReferenceException`); none of it showed on screen. For the page: the Steam store carries no English title — `appdetails?appids=2340650&l=english` still returns `古龙风云录` — so the slug needs a romanisation. (Heluo / 香港商河洛互動娛樂股份有限公司, published by 心火游戏, 31 Jan 2024.)
